data.narrative:
Loft Orbital is a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $326M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 7 private peers at the same or adjacent stage (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Impulse Space at $4.3B, Apex Space at $2.3B, Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B, Varda Space Industries at $1.6B, and two additional comparable firms) plus 5 public Space & Aerospace companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median 24.6x price-to-sales.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $326M total capital raised as a proxy for current value, yielding $554M. Peer-median analysis across the 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a $2.0B median valuation, with a range spanning $1.15B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures. These two methods produce a triangulated range of $471M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.3B.

The wide spread—from $471M to $2.3B—reflects material uncertainty around revenue traction, mission manifest, and capital efficiency relative to peers. The peer-median implies meaningfully higher valuation than stage-progression alone, suggesting market pricing for similar-stage space ventures has moved significantly. Key data gaps include Loft Orbital's revenue run rate and unit economics relative to the comp set.
